no-restricted-syntax.message: Arbitrary values are not allowed — use a design token. Every colour, size, and spacing step belongs in app/theme.css. Allowed exceptions: arbitrary properties ([--token:...]) and arbitrary variants ([&:hover]).

Raw palette colours are not allowed — use a semantic token from app/theme.css (canvas, surface, line, ink, action, link, focus) so a rebrand stays a one-file change. brand-50..900 remains available for decorative use.
Raw neutral keywords are not allowed — use a semantic token. Use bg-surface or text-ink rather than white, and bg-canvas-inverse rather than black, so both themes stay coherent.
